[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.18.1 - Slayer of Innocents, on the hooks the designers built for it[/b][/size]

Repair only, and it comes out of a good question rather than a bug report.

0.18.0 restored a title the game describes, reads eight times and had never once awarded: Child Killer,
display name Slayer of Innocents, "TITLE PERK: Killing the helpless is what you like to do." It hung the
award on murdering an unarmed citizen, because children cannot be killed -- Generic Child is AC 1000 /
HP 10000 and every child in the game uses that one race.

Then somebody asked about the three child-rescue quests: the woodcutter's daughter in the wilderness,
Marisol outside the sewers, Tomas in the troll pit. Are any of them killable? No -- but checking turned up
the mechanism the designers actually built. Every child's generator carries a working damaged hook. You
cannot kill them, but hitting one has always been detected, and always had consequences.

Hit the woodcutter's daughter and she screams, will not speak to you again, flees, the goblin guarding her
turns on you, the whole peaceful-resolution script set is deleted, "Find the Woodcutter's lost son" fails, a
flag called "daughter attacked" is set -- which her father's own dialogue reads, so he knows -- and a
cross-map action deletes her generator at the house so she never turns up home. Hit Marisol and "Find the
lost boy Tomas in the Sewers" fails. Hit the shepherd's son in Montaillou and two flags fire, one of them
called "Make Maury mad for hurting son."

Five children, six placements, every hook doing real work, and not one of them touching the title the game
wrote for exactly this. The grant sits in all six now, with every vanilla action left in place and in the
same order.

Everything downstream already worked. The grant reaches the Gate District guards' challenge -- "There have
been reports of a monstrous killer of helpless children...you loosely fit the description. Why should I not
bring you before the Inquisition?" -- and the second reply, "I am the killer. You should back down before I
kill you.", makes the guard shout "Have at thee, monster!" and the district turn on you. Five authored nodes
across two guard trees, and the grant was the only link missing since release.

The hooks cannot misfire: on all four maps nothing can target a neutral, which is what every child is, so
only the player can trigger one. The goblin standing over the daughter and the trolls standing over Tomas
cannot earn you a title.

Children are still unkillable and still will be -- that invulnerability is a deliberate shipped decision and
this mod does not touch it. The citizen grant from 0.18.0 stays alongside the new hooks, because a murdered
citizen is one of the helpless too. Forty grants in total.

One correction while I am here: 0.18.0's notes said Barcelona Boy sets Has Hit Points=0 as a second layer of
protection. It does not. All 247 character templates set it, including the HP-12 citizens and the HP-1
barstool patron in the Port District tavern. It is a level-part field about object hit points, not character
invulnerability, and the race presets are the only thing protecting children.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. These are level parts, so the new hooks need a character who has not
yet entered Scar Ravine, the Port District, the Troll Pit or Montaillou.

https://github.com/EricHype/LionheartFixt/releases/tag/v0.18.1
